observations: TXN reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.463B, up 23% year over year, with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive.
For the first six months of 2026, revenue was $10.288B versus $8.517B in the prior-year period; gross profit was $6.151B versus $4.888B and operating profit was $4.118B versus $2.887B.
Analog first-half 2026 revenue was $8.289B and operating profit $3.630B; Embedded Processing revenue was $1.511B and operating profit $290M.
TXN expects 2026 capital expenditures of $2B-$3B; it states that future capex will depend on revenue and growth expectations.
TXN disclosed up to $1.6B of CHIPS Act direct funding for three large-scale 300mm wafer fabs in Sherman, Texas and Lehi, Utah, with $630M received as of the filing.

The filing states higher manufacturing costs from planned capacity expansions partially offset gross-profit growth, while higher factory loadings spread fixed costs over output and can increase margins absent other circumstances.

risks.risk: Planned capacity expansions are already adding manufacturing costs; if revenue/loadings weaken, fixed-cost absorption and returns on the 300mm build can deteriorate.

unknowns.unknown: The filing does not provide a peer-relative valuation conclusion or a standalone utilization percentage for the new 300mm fabs; those remain Alpha underwriting work.

lineage.note: Adds a regulator-hosted SEC filing origin distinct from the packet's sole issuer:TXN:2026Q2 origin. This is source acquisition only; no numeric underwriting or causal judgment is asserted.
